name: InitTimedObject
evidence: slot 0 of the 0x30 class: runs the base set-up func_001B7968, sets the mode at 0x554 to 0 and the state at 0x558 to -1

name: SetTimedObjectTarget
evidence: slot 76: stores its argument in 0x550, the object whose state and time the subclasses read

name: EnterTimedObjectState
evidence: slot 77: stores the new state at 0x558 and the time D_0026185C[0] at 0x55C (after notifying the target when going from 1 to 2)

name: IsObjectInAcceptLists
evidence: returns 1 when everything is accepted (0x5B4) or the object matches an entry of the lists at 0x564/0x58C, 0 when IsObjectExcluded matches

name: IsObjectExcluded
evidence: returns 1 when the key matches an entry of the lists at 0x578 or 0x5A0 (tested with func_001833F0 and func_001300E8)

name: IsSoleAcceptedObject
evidence: returns 1 when the accept list holds exactly one object id, no class ids, nothing is accept-all and that id matches the argument

name: StopTrackPlayer
evidence: takes the object's track player (FindTrackPlayer), keeps the value at its 0x18 in +0x5CC, zeroes it and keeps the player at +0x5C8; UpdateTimedObject gives it back, and the sequenced and blink objects' state code calls it when the player accepts their message

name: UpdateTimedObject
evidence: slot 17 (update) of class 0x30: runs UpdateCollider, then gives the track player kept at +0x5C8 its value at 0x18 back once the player's state at 0x2220 is no longer 4; the three subclasses' updates call it first

name: AddTimedObjectAcceptedObjectId
evidence: appends a value to the id list at 0x564 while its count is below 4

name: AddTimedObjectExcludedObjectId
evidence: appends a value to the id list at 0x578 while its count is below 4

name: AddTimedObjectAcceptedClassId
evidence: appends a value to the id list at 0x58C while its count is below 4

name: AddTimedObjectExcludedClassId
evidence: appends a value to the id list at 0x5A0 while its count is below 4

name: InitTimedGroup
evidence: slot 0 of the 0x31 class: runs InitTimedObject and sets the fade at 0xB04 to 1.0

name: LoadTimedGroup
evidence: slot 10 (load) of class 0x31: runs LoadCollider, then resolves the two object links of g_timedGroupLinks (+0xAE4, +0xAE8)

name: PostLoadTimedGroup
evidence: slot 15 (after loading) of class 0x31: runs PostLoadPlacedObject, then walks the object's children and files the effect spawners among them into its groups at +0x5E0

name: CloneTimedGroupEntries
evidence: slot of the 0x31 class: for each group after the first, creates copies (func_00183058) of the first group's entries and copies their values, then calls slot 77 with 0x560

name: StaggerGroupOffsets
evidence: counts the world-list (+0x1CA8) objects not in state 8 and gives each an offset at 0xAFC spaced by (1/30)/count, then clears g_groupStaggerDirty

name: UpdateTimedGroup
evidence: slot 17 of the 0x31 class: steps the fade at 0xB04 by frame time times 0xB08 clamped to 0..1, then moves the state by elapsed time against 0x5B8, 0x5BC and 0xAEC and enters it through slot 77

name: SetStaggeredColliderFrozen
evidence: calls SetColliderFrozen, then removes or appends the collider in the world list at +0x1CA8 (flag AF8 tracks membership) and sets g_groupStaggerDirty

name: DrawTimedGroup
evidence: slot 37 of class 0x31 (the draw slot of QueuePlacedObjectDraw and DrawPlayer): runs class 0x03's func_001B93D8, then places the group's children by ComputeTimedGroupRamp on back memory

name: IsTimedGroupCandidate
evidence: tells whether a body may set a class 0x31 object off: not when its flag bit 43 is set, its root is the object's, IsObjectExcluded rejects it or it is the player in state 6/3 with func_00160D10's bits 0x12000; otherwise the low bit of its high flags clear; ChooseTimedGroupState calls it

name: ChooseTimedGroupState
evidence: slot 72 (0x130, pick the next state) of class 0x31: finds the nearest object the group may act on (FindNearestSpanObject, IsTimedGroupCandidate, IsObjectInAcceptLists) and tells it or the player (InitOwnerMessage, StopTrackPlayer)

name: SetTimedGroupMode
evidence: slot 73 of the 0x31 class: stores the mode at 0x554 and enters state 1 for mode 0, 5 otherwise

name: RequestTimedGroupEnd
evidence: slot 74 of the 0x31 class: unless in state 8, enters state 3 (mode 0) or 7 (the other mode), the states that time out into 8

name: FinishTimedGroup
evidence: slot 75 (0x13C) of class 0x31: moves a state 0 to 2 on to the closing state 3 and sets +0x554 to 1

name: EnterTimedGroupState
evidence: slot 77 of the 0x31 class: starts a sound when leaving state -1 or 8, stops it and calls slot 3 on reaching 8, then runs EnterTimedObjectState

name: ComputeTimedGroupRamp
evidence: returns a scale (config +4 or +8) times a 0..1 ramp from the elapsed time in the current state against 0x5B8, 0x5BC or 0xAEC, capped by the fade at 0xB04

name: SetTimedGroupFadeOutTime
evidence: stores -1/x in the fade rate at 0xB08 that UpdateTimedGroup adds to the fade each frame

name: SetTimedGroupFadeInTime
evidence: stores 1/x in the fade rate at 0xB08 that UpdateTimedGroup adds to the fade each frame

name: InitSequencedObject
evidence: slot 0 of the 0x32 class: runs InitTimedObject and sets the substate at 0x5D8 to -1

name: SetupSequencedObject
evidence: set-up of the 0x32 class: links its tables, defaults the two references at 0x5D0/0x5D4, sets a flag bit, then calls slot 77 with 0x560

name: UpdateSequencedObject
evidence: slot 17 of the 0x32 class: moves the state by elapsed time and, in state 6, steps the substate at 0x5D8 (0, 1, 2) against 0x5E0, 0x5E4, 0x5E8

name: DrawSequencedObject
evidence: slot 37 of class 0x32 (the draw slot): builds the object's transform (BuildPlacedObjectTransform) and a scaled matrix (BuildScaledTransformMatrix) from the time in its state

name: TestSequencedObjectMayContact
evidence: slot 56 (0xF0, may-contact test) of class 0x32: always 1

name: IsSequencedObjectCandidate
evidence: tells whether a body may set a class 0x32 object off: not when its flag bit 43 is set, its root is the active switched collider or the object's own, or IsObjectExcluded rejects it; otherwise the low bit of its high flags clear (ChooseSequencedObjectState)

name: ChooseSequencedObjectState
evidence: slot 72 (0x130, pick the next state) of class 0x32: looks at the player and the nearest span object (FindNearestSpanObject, IsSequencedObjectCandidate) to pick the state UpdateSequencedObject enters

name: SetSequencedObjectMode
evidence: slot 73 of the 0x32 class: stores the mode at 0x554 and enters state 1 for mode 0, 5 otherwise

name: RequestSequencedObjectEnd
evidence: slot 74 of the 0x32 class: unless in state 8 enters 3 or 7 by mode, then copies the target's state 1 into 0x5C0 when it entered that state within 0.2s

name: FinishSequencedObject
evidence: slot 75 (0x13C) of class 0x32: sets +0x554 to 1 the first time and moves the object to the closing state 3 unless it is in state 8

name: EnterSequencedObjectState
evidence: slot 77 of the 0x32 class: leaves substate on state 6 exit, starts substate 0 on entering 6, clears 0x5C0 leaving 8, then runs EnterTimedObjectState

name: EnterSequencedSubstate
evidence: changes the substate at 0x5D8: stops a sound leaving 1, sets the field 0x44 of the object at 0x200 on entering 0 or 2, starts a sound on 1, stores the time at 0x5DC

name: InitBlinkObject
evidence: slot 0 of the 0x33 class: runs InitTimedObject and sets the three frame ranges and the blink frame to -1

name: SetupBlinkObject
evidence: set-up of the 0x33 class: picks the first element of kind 1 with a nonzero 0x14 into 0x610, then calls slot 77 with 0x560

name: UpdateBlinkObject
evidence: slot 17 of the 0x33 class: moves the state by elapsed time against 0x5B8, 0x5BC, 0x608, 0x60C, enters it through slot 77 and calls the frame selector

name: ChooseBlinkObjectState
evidence: slot 72 (0x130, pick the next state) of class 0x33: walks its root's contacts for a body touching it that IsObjectInAcceptLists accepts, picks state 2 or 6, and tells the player (InitOwnerMessage, StopTrackPlayer) or another object (FindNodeForQuery)

name: SetBlinkObjectMode
evidence: slot 73 of the 0x33 class: stores the mode at 0x554 and enters state 1 for mode 0, 5 otherwise

name: RequestBlinkObjectEnd
evidence: slot 74 of the 0x33 class: same body as RequestSequencedObjectEnd (enters 3 or 7 by mode, copies the target's state 1 within 0.2s)

name: FinishBlinkObject
evidence: slot 75 (0x13C) of class 0x33: sets +0x554 to 1 and, when it has no hold time (+0x608 negative), moves state 1 to 3 and 5 to 7

name: EnterBlinkObjectState
evidence: slot 77 of the 0x33 class: stops the sound leaving 1 or 5, starts one on entering 1 or 5, then runs EnterTimedObjectState

name: SetBlinkObjectFrame
evidence: picks the frame range of the current state (alternating with the blink frame in states 3 and 7), computes the frame from elapsed time, looping or ping-pong, and passes it to func_001B46E0
